question: Does a fixed Gaussian-kernel estimate of the next P5 maximum, conditioned on the immediately previous P5 maximum, improve probabilistic ranking over the exact order-statistic null?

hypothesis.target: P5_t = maximum of the five numbers in draw t
hypothesis.kernel: K_h(c,m)=exp(-0.5*((c-m)/h)^2), with c the previous maximum of a historical transition and m=P5_(t-1)
hypothesis.direction: lower multiclass Brier score and higher Top-5 maximum hit rate than the exact null

temporal_protocol.cutoff_rule: For target row t, only transitions (P5[j-1],P5[j]) with j<t may be in the model state. Score target t before adding transition (P5[t-1],P5[t]) to the state for later targets.
temporal_protocol.selection_rule: Select one bandwidth using minimum validation mean multiclass Brier score; ties choose the larger bandwidth. No OOS-based selection or retuning.

endpoints.primary: Blind OOS mean multiclass Brier improvement = Brier(exact null) - Brier(kernel model); positive is better.
endpoints.secondary: Blind OOS Top-5 hit-rate difference = model Top-5 hit indicator minus exact-null Top-5 hit indicator; positive is better.

inference.paired_null: One-sided block sign-flip test on target-paired differences, contiguous blocks of 7 targets, with the final partial block retained.
inference.bootstrap: Circular moving-block bootstrap of target-paired differences, block length 7, percentile 95% interval.
inference.multiple_testing: Holm step-down across all 8 preregistered blind-OOS p-values: 4 bandwidths x (primary Brier improvement, secondary Top-5 improvement).

guardrails: The exact order-statistic null is analytical and fixed before evaluating targets.
The model uses only previous maxima from already completed draws; target P5 is read only after its ranking is fixed.
No feature, bandwidth, shrinkage or split is selected using blind OOS.
All four fixed bandwidths are reported; no post-hoc bandwidth is added.
The experiment is research-only and cannot change production SONAR or any prospective freeze.
Historical blind OOS has been exposed to prior laboratory work and is not a virgin holdout.
The 8-test Holm family covers this experiment only, not the full prior SONAR research history.
next_action: Run the fixed strict-prior walk-forward, persist every target's cutoff and candidate metrics, independently replay in CI, and retain the experiment as exploratory regardless of historical result.
